name: Claude Code
description: Installs Anthropic's native Claude Code binary (claude) at an exact version, checked against a sha256 you supply, with its auto-updater and manual updates turned off. No Node.js needed. There are no default pins.

version.description: Claude Code version to install (e.g. 2.1.312). Set it with its sha256 here, or as CLI_CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION in the image environment, or in the pins file. There is no default.

sha256_amd64.description: sha256 of the linux-x64 claude binary (platforms.linux-x64.checksum in the release's manifest.json), needed on amd64. Set it here, or as CLI_CLAUDE_CODE_SHA256_AMD64 in the image environment, or in the pins file, in the same place as the version.

sha256_arm64.description: sha256 of the linux-arm64 claude binary (platforms.linux-arm64.checksum in the release's manifest.json), needed on arm64. Set it here, or as CLI_CLAUDE_CODE_SHA256_ARM64 in the image environment, or in the pins file, in the same place as the version.

pins_file.description: Path of the pins file in the image, read when neither the options nor the image environment set a pin. Empty means /etc/devcontainer-features/pins.env.
